description: Configure routing for the Terms of Service page in the main application entry point

userStories.title: Register Terms page route in App.jsx
userStories.description: As a user, I want to be able to navigate to /terms so that I can view the terms of service page.
acceptanceCriteria: Import Terms component from './pages/Terms' in src/App.jsx
Add a new Route inside the Routes component with path='/terms'
Assign the <Terms /> component to the element prop of the new Route
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that /terms loads the Terms component
